title: Atomic Energy Commission 'born secret' restricted data
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Atomic Energy Commission 'born secret' restricted data, about 1946 onward at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Atomic Energy Commission outlined this sort of restricted data where if you were to collect anything that had any radiological features, alpha, beta, gamma radiation, it would be born secret.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, explains that the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency set up after the Second World War to control nuclear matters, created a category called restricted data starting around 1946. According to him, anything collected that showed signs of radiation was 'born secret', meaning it was classified from the moment it existed. He brings it up because it would explain how material from unexplained objects could be hidden by law automatically.
